selection_policy: Primary papers, official product/API documentation, and repository-native evidence only. General claims are not treated as Go2 validation.

external_sources.title: GPT-Realtime-2 Model
used_for: current realtime model modalities and function-calling surface
128k context and configurable reasoning tradeoff
text and audio list rates used in the explicitly modelled cost projection
external_sources.scope_note: Pricing and features are temporally unstable. No API call or model-quality inference was made. The page says structured outputs are not supported, which strengthens the need for a local typed validator.

external_sources.title: Voice agents
used_for: live audio path recommendation for barge-in, low first-audio latency, natural turn taking, and realtime tool use
distinguishing speech-to-speech from chained voice architectures
external_sources.scope_note: Architecture guidance, not a latency guarantee for Parcel, Starlink, or mounted audio.

external_sources.title: Realtime conversations
used_for: stateful session lifecycle and conversation events
60-minute session maximum
tool/result and session-update architecture
external_sources.scope_note: Provider session state does not replace robot action, safety, or long-term-memory authority.

external_sources.title: Voice activity detection (VAD)
used_for: server VAD versus semantic VAD
turn-start/turn-stop events and endpointing controls
external_sources.scope_note: The repo's frozen acoustic failures remain the prototype-specific evidence; documentation does not prove mounted endpointing.

external_sources.title: Managing costs
used_for: audio-token assumptions of 1 token/100 ms user audio and 1 token/50 ms assistant audio
context accumulation and caching caveats
external_sources.scope_note: The experiment's price output is arithmetic over authored durations and token counts, not a bill forecast.

external_sources.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
used_for: combining language relevance with available skills and affordance values
keeping embodiment grounding outside free-form language generation
external_sources.scope_note: Evaluated on a mobile manipulator, not a Go2 companion. It motivates the architecture but supplies no Parcel score.

external_sources.title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
used_for: closed-loop success, scene, and human feedback for embodied planning
typed action receipts rather than one-shot completion narration
external_sources.scope_note: Domains and feedback sources differ from Parcel; some evaluations use privileged descriptors.

external_sources.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
used_for: separate evaluation of extraction, multi-session reasoning, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention
session decomposition, fact-bearing keys, and time-aware queries

external_sources.title: RouteLLM: Learning to Route LLMs with Preference Data
used_for: motivation to evaluate routing quality and cost jointly
strong/weak tier routing as a learnable follow-up after deterministic safety routing
external_sources.scope_note: General LLM benchmarks; its reported >2x cost reductions in some settings are not transferred to Parcel.

external_sources.title: Adding Determinism to a Dialogue Agent for a Robotic Environment
external_sources.authors: Oihana Garcia Anakabe, Riccardo Cocola, Cristina Aceta
used_for: explicit dialogue state and transition graphs around an LLM
ambiguous, incomplete, and operator-error scenarios
external_sources.scope_note: Robot demonstration dialogue, not social companionship or physical-action safety certification.

external_sources.title: Graph-to-Text Approach to Knowledge-Grounded Response Generation in Human-Robot Interaction
external_sources.authors: Nicholas Thomas Walker, Stefan Ultes, Pierre Lison
used_for: continuously updated graph state from language, sensors, and spatial modules
compact graph-to-text state rendering for grounded HRI answers
external_sources.scope_note: Small human-robot study on tour recall; it does not establish long-term companion memory quality.

external_sources.title: When May I Help You? On The Effect of Proactivity on Group Human-Robot Collaboration
external_sources.authors: Thomas Vitry, Vanessa Maeder, Kieran von Valeburg, Asihati Hazaiti, Doga Deniz Ates, Connor Gade, Jan-Gerrit Habekost, Dennis Becker, Stefan Wermter
used_for: evidence that proactive contribution can increase interaction while also disrupting coordination or turn taking
need to evaluate initiative by owner/group traits and task context rather than maximizing interaction count
external_sources.scope_note: Collaborative escape-room study with a humanoid robot, not a domestic quadruped. The abstract reports descriptively higher overall success for the reactive condition, so it supports owner-conditioned initiative and measurement rather than a universal reactive/proactive winner.

external_sources.title: ProVox: Personalization and Proactive Planning for Situated Human-Robot Collaboration
external_sources.authors: Jennifer Grannen, Siddharth Karamcheti, Blake Wulfe, Dorsa Sadigh
external_sources.version_or_snapshot: arXiv:2506.12248v1, 2025-06-13; accepted IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 2025
used_for: explicit pre-interaction preference/meta-prompting before proactive planning
measuring user burden, helpfulness, ease of use, reliability, and task efficiency together
external_sources.scope_note: Household manipulation collaboration, not companion conversation. The reported task-efficiency/user-burden improvements do not authorize Parcel to infer travel or owner intent without its local consent/capability gate.

external_sources.title: PACT: Proactive Asking for Continual Task Assistance in Human-Robot Collaboration
used_for: ask-or-act decisions under partial observation and cross-day history
clarification utility as assistance accuracy balanced against question frequency
external_sources.scope_note: Continual task-assistance experiments, not social companionship or physical Go2 validation. It motivates clarification utility and abstention, not unrestricted proactivity.

external_sources.title: Towards Senior-Robot Interaction: Reactive Robot Dog Gestures
external_sources.authors: Chunyang Meng, Eduardo B. Sandoval, Ricardo Sosa, Francisco Cruz
used_for: curriculum-trained social quadruped gestures in Isaac Gym
explicit evidence that high simulation success still leaves joint-compliance, load-distribution, and balance transfer problems
external_sources.scope_note: The abstract reports >95% average simulation success and physical validation of a key paw-lift gesture, not every gesture and not Parcel's Go2 configuration.

external_sources.title: NVIDIA Jetson Modules
used_for: AGX Orin series edge-compute positioning and up-to-275-TOPS claim
external_sources.scope_note: TOPS is not conversational latency and says nothing about the proposed concurrent sensor/audio workload.

external_sources.title: Jetson Benchmarks
external_sources.version_or_snapshot: live page accessed 2026-08-26; AGX Orin MLPerf v4.0 row uses JetPack 5.1.1, TensorRT 9.0.1, CUDA 11.4
used_for: counterexample to assuming any 6B model is naturally realtime: published GPT-J 6B single-stream latency 10204.46 ms on that old stack
need for exact-model, exact-stack, exact-power-mode Orin benchmarks
external_sources.scope_note: Old GPT-J summarization benchmark, not a current optimized streaming conversational model and not a prediction for a chosen Parcel edge model.

repository_sources.used_for: SI/DI versioning, realtime companion wording, tool schemas, start/terminal receipts, and response-initiator authority
effective Go2 emote/pose/tool closure and duplicate prompt-plane audit
tiered memory, turn/provenance snapshots, and current dialogue-context surface
committed conversation, acoustic, navigation, and mount-readiness evidence
event-driven initiative baseline and exact owner-identity/untyped-contract refuters

unavailable_requested_artifact.observation: The unauthenticated artifact URL did not expose reviewable artifact content in this environment; a rendered attempt showed a not-found page and the inner frame endpoint was inaccessible.
unavailable_requested_artifact.consequence: No design, code, result, or readiness claim in this research artifact is attributed to the inaccessible Claude artifact. Only repository-committed Claude/QEV evidence is reviewed.
